items.title: Jim H. Dunbar Jr. Interview, 1959-11-28
items.q: Wallace Davenport used to be with them, but I never heard him do anything real tasty and he was sort of playing a little bit out of his idiom

ctx.x: Parades and funerals for five dollars, they're doing it for fun.

I talked to an old guy about a week ago who's not a member of this band, but he's a working musician, his name is Gaino, George Gaino, he plays a banjo. And George was talking, I don't know how much he works, not I guess as much as some musician, but he was really excited about having worked the job and making 16 dollars for, I don't know, five, six hours. Real excited about that. So certainly, and he was excited not because he thought 16 dollars was big money, but it was unusual money, you see. So certainly…
